statement: Consider a sequence of smooth positive probability densities η on finite-dimensional Euclidean spaces, with finite second moments. Let A = −∆ − D log η · D, and suppose that η satisfies Poincaré with constant at most λ−1, where λ → 1. Fix s = 1/8. Suppose smooth vector fields b, w and a symmetric matrix field K satisfy D log η = − y − b(y) s + ω(y), Db = Id − sK, 0 ≤ K ≤ s−1 Id, 29 where either ω = w throughout the sequence or ω = 0 throughout the sequence. Assume b, w ∈ L2(η), w is a gradient, and, with I = ∥w∥2 2 > 0, w ∈ Dom A, ∥(A − 1)w∥2 = o( √ I), |Eηw| = o( √ I), ⟨w, Kw⟩2 = o(I). (5.1) Assume also the following prediction and projection properties. (i) For Y ∼ η and an independent standard Gaussian G, set Ur = Y + √ r G, hr(u) = E[w(Y ) | Ur = u], m(r) = I−1 E|hr(Ur)|2 . For every fixed 0 < r < 1/4, one has m(r) → e−r. (ii) For every fixed c < ∞, sup Π2=Π=Π∗ deterministic rank Π≤cI ∥Πw∥2 2 = o(I). (5.2) For every ϵ > 0 there is a deterministic projection Πϵ of rank at most CϵI such that ∥E[(1 − Πϵ)bb∗ (1 − Πϵ)]∥op + ∥E[(1 − Πϵ)ωω∗ (1 − Πϵ)]∥op ≤ ϵ (5.3) eventually along the sequence. (iii) If ω = w, the conditional covariance Cr = Cov(w(Y ) | Ur) satisfies, for every fixed r ∈ (0, 1/4) and a > 0, E tr ( Cr1{Cr>a} ) = o(I). (5.4) No conditional covariance-tail assumption is made when ω = 0. Then there are totally symmetric tensor fields Tl of order l + 1, for every fixed integer l ≥ 0, with T0 = w, such that ∥Tl∥2 2 = (1 + o(1))I, ∥(A − 1)Tl∥2 = o( √ I), ∥DTl − Tl+1∥2 = o( √ I). (5.5) ⟨Tl, K1Tl⟩2 = o(I). (5.6) sup Π2=Π=Π∗ deterministic rank Π≤cI ∥Π1Tl∥2 2 = o(I) for every fixed c < ∞. (5.7) Every Tl belongs componentwise to Dom A. For l ≥ 1 it can be chosen in ⋂ p≥1 Dom Ap. By symmetry, the specified slot in Equations (5.6) and (5.7) may be any slot. All assertions can be made simultaneous for any fixed finite collection of levels and parameters.
